tests.description: realistic merged GitHub Actions SBOM suggestion

suggestions.title: Add CycloneDX SBOM generation job to build.yml
suggestions.rationale: SEBI CSCRF GV.SC.S5 expects regulated entities to maintain a software bill of materials for critical applications. The trading-gateway-api GitHub Actions workflow builds and pushes an image but never records its dependency inventory. This diff adds an sbom job that runs cyclonedx-gomod on the module, uploads sbom.cdx.json as a 400-day artefact and fails the workflow if generation fails, so every production image has a matching SBOM
suggestions.decisionNote: Accepted; pinned the cyclonedx-gomod action to a commit SHA during review
